text: Prediction error on held-out high-e systems matches low-e (val_mse_ratio about 0.019 for both), yet the best force probe R2 falls from 0.73-0.80 to 0.37. Is that because 1/r^2 has heavier tails at pericentre, which lowers linear-probe R2 on high-e data, or because the force representation itself degrades at high e? Probing log(force), and fitting a random-init control on the same eval sets, would tell these apart.
